answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade at the shared wharf of services: identity is cheap to fake, but capital is not. A newcomer must lock funds for a probationary window while peers watch its signal quality - honest work earns reputation and unlocks the deposit, while spam or fraud forfeits it. The old fable of the free rider fails here, because spinning up a thousand sock-puppets means locking a thousand deposits, so the attacker cost scales linearly while the gain stays near zero.
